existing_finding_connections.first_failed_contract: The sky observer invokes a unit-returning screenshot save callback, then bases final success on image metrics and camera readiness without retaining successful file persistence.
existing_finding_connections.trace: The CLI supplies an output PathBuf described as a PNG path and forwards it without a source-level extension guard. Sky capture reads screenshot dimensions and metrics, calls Bevy save_to_disk(path)(captured), writes a manifest and sends Success if its semantic gates pass. Pinned Bevy0.19.1 converts the image and identifies an image format using the path; conversion, unrecognized extension and save errors are logged inside a unit-returning observer rather than returned. Pinned image0.25.10 from_path resolves path.extension via from_extension; an unlisted suffix returns an Unsupported error.
existing_finding_connections.conditional_example: If an output such as capture/sky.notimage reaches the observer, native conversion succeeds, the image-format helper receives its unlisted suffix, the image metrics/camera gates pass and the separate manifest write succeeds, the save helper logs an unsupported-format error while the outer sky observer can send Success. The CLI describes a PNG output, so that suffix is outside its documented intended output; source argument admission does not itself reject it. No command, conversion, file write, metrics or exit was run.
existing_finding_connections.safeguards: Conversion failure also returns no save result to the sky observer, but an actual native image format and save failure have not been witnessed. Manifest IO can independently fail and prevent success; missing screenshot callbacks and deadline behavior are separate. The sky setup creates its parent and attempts to remove only the failure marker, with no fresh-output check in the inspected source; no pre-existing image, stale artifact or actual path race has been observed. Existing scene-capture q257 shares the native helper but has a separate owner and fresh-directory guard, so no exact alias is asserted.
